completed_scope: OCI proxy management accepts explicit additional delivery authorities and opt-in opaque signed query use. Ordinary npm/PyPI durable URL validation remains unchanged.

Every redirect selects the longest approved source path before query validation. Each request uses only that source credential; registry bearers, realm credentials, downstream tokens, cookies and Referer cannot cross delivery authority.

All destination addresses remain subject to common CIDRs, operator private-network ceilings and approved-address dialing; HTTPS downgrade is rejected. Token realms still reject redirects, and CDN challenges cannot start a registry token exchange.

Operator flags configure hop, URL byte, query byte and query-pair budgets. Query order/escaping/repetition is preserved. Ephemeral Locations/query URLs are not durable bindings, and origin/realm/delivery errors are sanitized, including malformed Locations parsed by net/http before CheckRedirect.

Two repeated real PostgreSQL/race/stock ORAS runs prove exact proxy/group bytes, renewed query URLs after root 304/member invalidation, no partial publication after integrity/query rejection, current policy and absence of ephemeral credentials in artifact/cache/repository/journal/job data.

A clean real Docker Hub/anonymous-token/CloudFront journey proves one pinned Linux arm64 BusyBox image through actual HTTPS delivery, including a missing-query-permission negative control, exact OCI layouts, cached generation, native process restart, member revalidation and current source/group denial.
All previous hosted/proxy/group native npm/Python/OCI/Maven/generic journeys replayed against identical clean binary identities.
